(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix User. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/manage-team-members/.
access_type  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Access type configuration - defines whether user access is permanent or temporary with expiration
access_type.permanent_access  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Permanent access configuration - user has indefinite access
access_type.temporary_access  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Temporary access configuration - user access expires at a specified time
access_type.temporary_access.expire_at  tftypes.String computed
    description: Timestamp when the user's temporary access will expire. After this time, the user will no longer be able to access the system.
active  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Whether the user is active. The provider manages the whole status of the user through this attribute: `false` deactivates the user, `true` activates them. It defaults to `true`.
allowed_login_mode  tftypes.List[tftypes.String] computed
    description: List of allowed login modes. Can include SSO, local authentication, or both. The order and repetitions of the configuration are kept in the state: the backend answers them in its own order, and the resource matches the configuration to that answer when it reads. Removing the attribute from the configuration keeps the modes the backend has; clearing them takes an explicit empty list `[]`.
groups  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
    description: The ids of the groups the user belongs to, as decimal strings, the values SCIM returned in groups[].value. A user with no memberships has a known empty set.
id  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: User ID. Exactly one of `id` or `user_name` must be set.
name  nested SINGLE computed
    description: The name of the user.
name.family_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The family (last) name of the user.
name.given_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The given (first) name of the user.
user_name  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: User name (email). Exactly one of `id` or `user_name` must be set. The lookup is case-insensitive, since SSO login can normalize letter case in the backend.
